author: Homo_S
quote:
The game doesn't meet expectations at all. 

First and foremost, the story, the characters, the writing is very bad, stale, soulless and boring. It's much worse than even in GTA1, even then it was really fun. In this regard it's the worst game in the franchise.

30 fps cap is pathetic.

The game isn't actually bad, but relative to its hype, brand, and status it's really 0/10.

Because of the scummy marketing and journo campaign it really deserves a huge backlash.

Strauss Zelnik, don't even think removing user reviews.

author: Homo_S
quote: The release of Cyberpunk 2077 made my returning to this game, and I want to say the game is amazing. Awesome stealth gameplay (the best I've ever seen), nice visuals, good story. If you think the story is stale, then play Deus Ex 1 and Human Revolution. The only complain is that it's short compared to HR, and it will never get a sequel. That's the saddest part about this game.

author: Homo_S
quote:
Cyberjunk, Cybertrash, Cyberscam 76.

This game is plagued with technical issues and has very poor visuals, but putting these things aside I want to say this game fails completely as a game. Open world is shallow, lifeless, wooden, and boring. It's like Deus Ex HR/MD with cars, except Deus Ex has great stealth gameplay with better story presentation through 3rd person talking sequences. The AI is very basic and almost non-existent. There are no police car chases, and police spawns right behind your back. The dialogues are sleep-inducing, boring, hacky, and corny.

People, appreciate Rockstar North more, GTA IV and GTA V are a billion light years ahead in terms of realism and open world design.

Remember -- CD Projekt RED promised us a revolution in all aspects, and under-delivered completely. The biggest disappointment in gaming history.

author: Homo_S
quote: I consider this game as a huge disappointment, even though I was really disappointed by Kojima's previous work (MGSV) and expected nothing.
